category_title: High-achieving students with proactive study habits and consistent attendance
scenario_title: Metacognitive reflection on study habits after biology exams
minimal_context: A student is reviewing their recent biology exam and discussing study habits during a peer fellow session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Welcome to the peer fellow session. Let's talk about the recent biology exam and your study habits.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I really need help to determine the causes of my difficulty on this exam. I thought I was prepared.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: How did you prepare for it?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I did my usual routine, but now I'm second-guessing everything. I don't feel confident in my habits anymore.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Take a look at the graphs of study habits on the document posted online.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I see the data, but I'm just overwhelmed and reacting to my score. I don't know how to combine these habits to find the best fit or figure out what actually went wrong for me.
